question: Among posts authored by users in the top 5 by reputation, find the text of the highest-scoring comment on any post that has between 50 and 500 views and was commented on by a user with fewer than 5 downvotes.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c."XCL_008"
FROM comments AS c
INNER JOIN posts AS p ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
INNER JOIN users AS u ON p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
INNER JOIN users AS cu ON c."XCL_010" = cu."XCL_052"
WHERE p."XCL_030" BETWEEN 50 AND 500
  AND u."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT "XCL_052" FROM users ORDER BY "XCL_053" DESC LIMIT 5
  )
  AND cu."XCL_062" < 5
ORDER BY c."XCL_007" DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH top_users AS (
    SELECT "XCL_052" AS user_id
    FROM users
    ORDER BY "XCL_053" DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
downvote_counts AS (
    SELECT "XCL_070" AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS downvote_count
    FROM votes
    WHERE "XCL_068" = 10
    GROUP BY "XCL_070"
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 5
)
